sequence.body:
Hi Mikhail,

Hope you’re having a great week! I really enjoyed reading in Shopify about Shopify’s momentum with AI and organic search are doing different jobs:—and seeing the recent update in Shopify on AI-referred shoppers convert better and spend more (2026) makes it clear how fast things are moving at Shopify right now.

As initiatives like this scale across Shopify, the toughest part is rarely the core software or AI model—it's getting clean, governed data flowing across systems without pulling senior engineers off the main roadmap.

At Algoworks, we help commerce and retail CTOs deploy our engineer for businessbuild for people to automate those underlying pipelines and cut months of custom integration work out of the critical path.

Would you be open to a quick look at the 2-page architecture playbook we used for a similar commerce and retail scale-up, or a brief 10-minute chat next week? Either way, wishing you and the Shopify team continued momentum!

Warm regards,
GODY
Algoworks

Warm regards,
